newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields fall with worldwide markets.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields fall with worldwide markets.

text.p: Debt yields fell several basis points on the back of stronger foreign markets and the crown remained stable against the mark but firmed against a generally weaker dollar.
Yields fell after a speech by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan which made the market lower its expectations of a rate cut in May.
"The speech by Greenspan shows he is optimistic about the slowdown in growth. That has given strength to markets. The German bund is down and Italian yields are falling," a dealer said.
The six month T-bill rate was two basis points down at 4.20 percent and the ten year bond yield dropped eight basis points to 7.02 percent.
The crown was stable at 4.5055 crowns to the mark versus 4.5000 crowns on Wednesday.
